system.description:
You breathe ambulatory motion and a dim semblance of understanding into cold corpses, raising tireless laborers to carry out your bidding.

Expend a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait, plus one Mental Trait for each corpse animated. These corpses have four health levels and suffer no wound penalties, but they cannot fight; they continue a single assigned task until it is complete or until time or damage destroys them. The cadavers keep rotting even while animated, though only at the slow rate of one health level per month.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
